method: Run 19 deterministic offline assertions against the complete lesson, metadata and DATA ledger. Compile the exact lesson Python fence, execute its corpus/placement helpers with a fake Anthropic SDK, and test strict scorer branches. Cross-check Anthropic stop-reason and Python SDK documentation, DeepSeek Anthropic-compatibility docs, the Chroma Context Rot report and Lost in the Middle paper. No provider request or historical run replay.

observations.trace: Anthropic model_context_window_exceeded is classified as incomplete alongside max_tokens. The example now leaves API-key/Bearer-token resolution to the Anthropic SDK instead of passing ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN as api_key. Fake-SDK execution verified the unique joint-match fixture and exact needle placement at all five tested positions.

limitations: Historical per-call prompts/responses, exact model/endpoint fingerprint, usage, scorer and sample map are unavailable; 15/15, 3/3 and capacity summaries cannot be independently recomputed.
No live provider call, endpoint authentication, inference, billing, latency or answer quality was tested.
The fake SDK confirms local client construction and prevents network calls; it does not verify real SDK headers or DeepSeek compatibility behavior.
Synthetic corpus checks validate only the constructed fixture and do not reproduce the historical dataset or establish long-context model capability.
